The comparison now turns on (1) whether restriction of favouring content is a limitation (row 3b: which favouring is the pure one), (2) an independent noncognitive instance with both marks of the cognition criterion, (3) goodness variation within one end-realization class for an original source, (4) the reception fork, shared by the wisdom route and the purity of good-generality once the criterion is granted, (5) a will-recognition bridge with the governing relation explicit.

current_assessment.scope: Joint coherence of (a)-(e) for an impersonal foundation; cross-family argument from finality to limitation and cognition
current_assessment.assessment: A simple, necessary, noncognitive foundation cannot have a favouring determined to one content under #2153's nonlimitation, L and admissibility premises plus the purity of good-generality and the one-favouring reading of simplicity; E is not used, because commitment (e) supplies the positive excluding determination. It can still be composite in its powers, hold a pure determination-to-one that excludes another pure perfection (denying joint compossibility), hold good-generality impure or inadmissible, or be good-general and noncognitive (denying the cognition criterion: a primitive relation to the betterness of non-present candidates at fixed end content, with no independent noncognitive instance identified). Selection among tied creations is a shared price; contingency of creation as such separates permissive from categorical accounts on both sides. The finality route is a horizontal conditional support option for 29818edd that uses neither 180f5ad2, fe67d766 nor E; it shares a30c5963, the inputs of L and, once the criterion is granted, the reception fork with the wisdom route. No unconditional ranking.
current_assessment.next_test: Is restriction of favouring content a limitation (RequiresLack test against PureRequiresNoPureLack, both sides)? Find or exclude an independent noncognitive instance with both marks of the criterion; decide goodness variation within a D-class for an original source; a will-recognition bridge with BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_3 explicit; register the controls as models and the core as a configuration.
